feeds.title: Journal of Clinical Epidemiology
feeds.description: The Journal of Clinical Epidemiology aims at promoting the quality of clinical epidemiologic and patient-oriented health services research:Through the advancement and application of innovative methods of conducting and presenting primary research; synthesizing research results; disseminating and translating results into optimal clinical practice; with special attention to the training of new generations of scientists and clinical practice leaders.

feeds.title: EpidemioLogical Blog
feeds.description: This is the blog/website of 'Epi Ren,' an epidemiologist who is currently a doctoral candidate at the Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg School of Public Health. My research interests have always been about infectious disease. However, I have lately gotten interested in applying communicable disease epidemiological methods to social problems.

feeds.title: West Coast Stat Views (on Observational Epidemiology)
feeds.description: Comments, observations and thoughts from two left coast bloggers on applied statistics, higher education, and epidemiology. Joseph is a new assistant professor. Mark is a marketing statistician and former math teacher.

feeds.title: International Journal of Epidemiology Blog
feeds.description: The official blog of the International Journal of Epidemiology. The IJE blog contextualizes and provides insight into epidemiological research related to the Journal's publication program. It aims to make the latest epidemiological discoveries accessible to an audience beyond the Journal's traditional readership, encourage debate, and help authors maximize the impact of their research.
